subject: Post-demo: validate token burn bands & founders-sweetener request
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Ahmed <samira@contextai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: validate token burn bands & founders-sweetener request

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can land next steps: 

1) High-level usage signal you shared: ~1.2M inference tokens/day initially (peak ~2.5M) for the NLU/response path, plus ~300K embedding tokens/week for search indexing.
2) You mentioned a preliminary monthly budget range of $30k–$45k for Q4 while you validate throughput and latency in staging.
3) Open ask from your end: eligibility for the Founders Track (starter credit + 20% off first 6 months) or a committed-use discount if ContextAI prefers a 6–12 month minimum.

Could you confirm the numbers above (daily burn / expected staging length) and whether procurement prefers a dollar-based commit or a token-based commitment? That will determine the structure of any multi-month sweetener we propose.

I attached a back-of-envelope pricing worksheet so you can see the $/1M token targets under different scenarios (baseline, quantized, and committed). If it helps, I can model a 6-month token commit vs. a $250k spend floor — each maps to different unit economics and availability of the Founders discount.

Tentative next steps: 
- You confirm burn and procurement preference (token vs $ commit) — Samira
- We model two scenarios and return an offer + T&Cs — Redwood
- If acceptable, we schedule procurement call to sort PO timing and security checklist — both

Thanks — trying to keep this lightweight so you can share with the rest of the team.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0138

Attachment: redwood-pricing-worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet; 1 sheet)

From: Samira Ahmed <samira@contextai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@contextai.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 17:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: validate token burn bands & founders-sweetener request

Thanks Irene — great demo and appreciate the clear follow-up. Quick answers from our side: 

- Numbers look right: target ~1.2M/day in staging for ~8 weeks, then ramp to ~3M/day in production (est first 60–90 days). Embeddings are optional at first but likely to increase monthly.
- Budget band: our executive sponsor carved out $30k–$45k/month for experimentation. If early results are good, we expect to re-up to $75k+/month.
- Procurement preference: they prefer a $-based commit (PO) rather than token accounting internally — easier for our finance team.

On discounts: Founders Track looks interesting; can you confirm what "starter credit" looks like in dollar terms and whether that stacks with a committed discount? Procurement is particularly interested in a multi-month price floor if we commit to ~$200k over 6 months.

Also copying procurement to start the PO timeline — their question: any constraints on invoice terms and SOC2 evidence we need to include?

—Samira
Samira Ahmed
Head of Product, ContextAI
samira@contextai.com

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: validate token burn bands & founders-sweetener request

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Samira's reply. Key points: procurement wants a $-based PO and is targeting ~$200k over 6 months as a potential floor; they have a confirmed staging burn of ~1.2M/day for ~8 weeks then a projected ramp. Asking: can we structure a 6-month committed-use pricing plan that (a) gives them a predictable unit $/1M tokens below the public hosted rate and (b) preserves Founders starter credit (if applicable) without violating program rules?

Notes for modeling: 
- Look at blended $/1M assuming 30–45k/month initial spend and ramp to 75k/month by month 3.
- Include quantized lower-cost variant for embedding workloads where possible.
- Confirm whether a one-time starter credit (e.g., $10k) can combine with a committed discount (legal prefers not to stack rebates, but we may be able to apply credit against initial invoice).

Can you mock 2 offers by EOD: (1) $200k 6-month spend-floor with tiered $/1M tiers and (2) a 6-month $50k/month commit that includes Founders starter credit + smaller unit discount? I'll share both back to customer.

Irene
Account Executive

On Tue, Sep 14, 2027 at 5:24 PM Samira Ahmed <samira@contextai.com> wrote:
> Thanks Irene — great demo...

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Ahmed <samira@contextai.com>, procurement@contextai.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: validate token burn bands & founders-sweetener request

Hi Samira / procurement team —

Thanks for the clarity. Attached are two scenarios (spreadsheet) and a short summary below so procurement can review quickly: 

Scenario A — $200k 6-month spend-floor
- Upfront or monthly PO accepted
- Blended unit price: $750 / 1M tokens (baseline model), with a path down to $520 / 1M after sustained ramp and KV-caching assumptions applied
- Founders starter credit: $12,000 applied to first invoice (one-time), can be used in conjunction with the committed program if PO references Founders participation
- Invoice terms: Net 30 standard; SOC2 Type II evidence link included in Drive attachment

Scenario B — $50k/month 6-month commit (total $300k) + Founders sweetener
- Effective unit price: $680 / 1M tokens initial, stepping to $540 / 1M after month 3 ramp
- Starter credit: $8,000 one-time (applied to month 1 invoice)
- Refund/rollback: standard non-refundable commitment but we provide a one-time quarterly headroom credit if burn drops >40% below forecast

Next steps: 
- Procurement to confirm PO cadence (monthly vs upfront) and approve invoice terms
- If agreed, I'll route a compact SOW + Founders T&C (attached) for signature and confirm on-boarding dates for a staging capacity slot the week after signature.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-worksheet.xlsx, Founders-Track-T&C.pdf

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0138
